name: turbocharger_combustion_products
title: Turbocharger matching with combustion-product composition (simplified formulation)
summary: Steady-state matching of a turbocharger on a supercharged engine: filter and compressor (given pressure ratio and isentropic efficiency), glycol-water intercooler (epsilon-NTU), combustion at the given AFR with the exhaust properties computed from the molar composition of the complete-combustion products (excess air, simplified dry air, ideal-gas CO2/H2O/O2/N2), turbine matched on the compressor power balance, equivalent exhaust-orifice diameter and heat-recovery percentages.

origin.course: MCI (ULiège), TP4 exercise 1: supercharging (formulation simplifiée, PNG 24/03/2019)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last consistent run of 109 stored values), compared with the runnable _coolsolve variant: 50 variables agree within 4.5e-3 relative (max, Q_dot_2; most within 1e-3). 12 absolute-enthalpy/entropy variables carry backend reference offsets (differences agree); 8 stored values are stale (h_p_* constant offset -82.87 MJ/kg, s_p_ex_e_s/s_p_su_e off-scale, p_su_e/r_p_e inconsistent with the stored w_e_s) - documented in the README.
verification.notes: The native file does not parse (C%); the comparison concerns the variant. The stored subprogram state (ref call) is reproduced under the flattened names (x_ref[i], h_ref[i], pp_ref[i]...).
